details:
* SECURITY UPDATE: arbitrary file deletion via malicious file list
     - debian/patches/CVE-2026-53789.patch: keep synthetic and legacy implied
       parent directories non-content in exclude.c, flist.c so a malicious
       sender cannot forge the transfer-root entry as a content directory and
       expand a scoped --delete beyond the requested path; additionally reject
       a non-directory transfer-root entry in flist.c so a forged "." file
       entry cannot be used with --force to recursively wipe the destination
     - CVE-2026-53789
